title: Finite-presentation modules over a filtered colimit of rings
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (A_i)_{i\in I} be a directed system of commutative rings with colimit A [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then the category of finitely presented A-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] is the colimit, under extension of scalars, of the categories of finitely presented A_i-modules: every finitely presented A-module is isomorphic to M_i\otimes_{A_i}A for some i and finitely presented M_i; every A-linear map between two such fixed base changes is the base change of an A_j-linear map between their base changes at some j\ge i; and two maps at a stage that become equal over A become equal after passage to a later stage.

source.place: Limits, Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR, first proof (affine case) via Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-colimit-category-fp-modules

proof.text: Choose a finite presentation A^{\oplus m} \to A^{\oplus n} \to M \to 0. The matrix entries have representatives in some A_i by the elementwise description of the filtered colimit. Let M_i be the cokernel of the represented matrix over A_i. After tensoring its presentation with A, the matrix is the original one, so M_i\otimes_{A_i}A is canonically isomorphic to M.

Fix a stage i and finitely presented A_i-modules M_i,N_i, with presentations A_i^r \xrightarrow{R_M} A_i^s \to M_i \to 0 and A_i^p \xrightarrow{R_N} A_i^q \to N_i \to 0. For an A-linear map M_i\otimes_{A_i}A \to N_i\otimes_{A_i}A, choose coefficient vectors in A^q for the images of the s generators of M_i and lift their finitely many entries to one later stage A_j by clause (1) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise]. For each of the finitely many columns of R_M, its image under the proposed map is zero in (N_i\otimes_{A_i}A)=\operatorname{coker}(R_N\otimes A); therefore its coefficient vector d_t in A^q is in the image of R_N\otimes A, so choose b_t\in A^p with d_t=(R_N\otimes A)b_t. Lift all entries of the finitely many b_t to a common later stage j by clause (1), and let d_t^{(j)}\in A_j^q be the combination of the lifted generator vectors with coefficients the t-th column of R_M, so that d_t^{(j)} maps to d_t. Each coordinate of d_t^{(j)}-R_Nb_t (lifted b_t) then maps to zero in A, so clause (2), applied to comparison with 0 and then combined by directedness, makes all these finitely many coordinate equalities hold at one further stage j'. The lifted generator vectors therefore kill the relations R_M there and define an A_{j'}-linear map M_i\otimes_{A_i}A_{j'}\to N_i\otimes_{A_i}A_{j'} whose base change is the given map.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-colimit-category-fp-modules, Tag 05N7, proof of (2), via Lemma module-map-property-in-colimit

proof.text: For two A_i-linear maps M_i \rightrightarrows N_i whose base changes to A are equal, use a finite presentation A_i^p \xrightarrow{R_N} A_i^q \to N_i\to0 and compare their values on finite generators of M_i. For each generator, the difference \varphi(x_k)-\psi(x_k)\in N_i is the image of a coefficient vector c_k\in A_i^q, and the class of the image of c_k in A^q is zero in (N_i\otimes_{A_i}A)=\operatorname{coker}(R_N\otimes A); hence choose b_k\in A^p with (image of c_k)=(R_N\otimes A)b_k. Lift all entries of the finitely many b_k to one stage by clause (1) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise]. Each coordinate of c_k-R_Nb_k (c_k pushed to that stage) maps to zero in A, and clause (2), followed by a common directed enlargement, makes all these coordinate equalities hold at one later stage. The differences then vanish in N_i\otimes_{A_i}A_{j'} on generators, j' that stage, so the two maps become equal after passage to that stage.

split_report.summary: Read Algebra Lemma 05N7 and its use in Limits Lemma 01ZR. The imported item is exactly the affine ring theorem, so I split its proof into the finite-presentation matrix construction, descent of a map using finitely many generator images and relations, and eventual equality of two maps using finitely many coefficient equations. All three steps use the existing elementwise filtered-colimit statement; no new node was created.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the affine case of the parent Noetherian-approximation step: finite-presentation module objects, maps, and equalities descend along the directed ring colimit.

tool_uses.why: Its element-representation and eventual-equality clauses supply the finite coefficient lifting used in all three matrix arguments.
